implementation.feature_loading: append one or more disjoint keypoint directories; descriptors are not retained by mapper replay
implementation.deferred_overlay: shift every addition keypoint by the frozen base count, retain same-time pairs plus a bounded temporal gap interval, append after the unchanged structure prefix
implementation.post_registration_retriangulation: build tracks from the deferred stream only after registration; reject every track touching a keypoint already owned by the base graph; triangulate against fixed registered poses; expose accepted tracks only to completion and final filter/refinement
implementation.complexity: O(features + verified correspondences + tracks); no image-pair Cartesian product and no N^2 persistent state

new_pairs_in_structure_without_dense_ste.diagnosis: the independent dense temporal graph had no same-time stereo edges and dominated PnP/local BA with non-metric tracks

same_time_supplements_in_structure.diagnosis: mixing dense stereo correspondences into base pair records changes pair-confidence ordering before registration

counter_fix_replay.reason: the first run initialized the retain index at first_new_track and therefore counted retained base tracks as deferred tracks; model output was unaffected

all_final_ba_single_anchor.diagnosis: freeing the second anchor before deferred dense tracks exist lets repeated-corridor monocular tracks move window scale

post_filter_metric_only_single_anchor.diagnosis: same-frame stereo labels do not create trustworthy metric connections across the drifting windows

full_local_chain_multiframe_metric_cap64.diagnosis: short dense chains recover bounded multi-frame metric tracks, but fixed window ends prevent scale correction and the 62 MiB RSS margin is too small for promotion
even explicit multi-frame metric-cycle tracks do not make a free sequential BA gauge robust enough in the repeated corridor

sequential_gap1_multiframe_metric_cap64_.diagnosis: adjacent-only verified tracklets remove long aliases and recover more multi-frame metric support with ample memory margin, but post-registration fixed-end refinement cannot undo existing drift

sequential_gap1_exact_quadrilateral_post.diagnosis: exact four-edge stereo-temporal identity is bounded and safe enough to preserve registration, but post-registration fixed-end refinement cannot use it to repair the already established gauge drift

sequential_gap1_exact_quadrilateral_afte.diagnosis: even exact descriptor quadrilaterals contain systematic repeated-corridor aliases: they improve the small component but strongly bias the dominant trajectory when exposed to incremental growth

sequential_gap1_photometric_quadrilatera.diagnosis: this first implementation filtered the deferred suffix used by both PnP registration and retriangulation, so its 18-image loss cannot be attributed to track quality; the corrected disjoint-copy experiment is recorded in m8-openloris-photometric-quadrilateral-ab.json

sequential_gap1_multiframe_metric_post_s.diagnosis: one post-registration scale-moving cycle is already unstable; metric BA gauge repair is closed

sequential_gap1_unvalidated_incremental_.diagnosis: exposing every adjacent metric cycle before seed selection improves the small component but shifts the dominant seed and introduces systematic scale bias

sequential_gap1_unvalidated_after_base_s.diagnosis: preserving base initialization does not remove the dominant-component bias, so unvalidated adjacent SIFT cycles themselves are unsafe

sequential_gap1_base_pose_reprojection_b.screen: base-only poses plus robust triangulation at the mapper 4 px reprojection gate; metric temporal-cycle tracks required stereo support in at least two frames
sequential_gap1_base_pose_reprojection_b.diagnosis: screening candidates against the same base geometry is circular: self-consistent repeated-corridor aliases pass reprojection, are replayed as structure, and amplify rather than independently correct the original gauge error

post_mapping_segment_gauge_diagnostic.interpretation: segment 6 falls from 0.8698 m global-frame RMSE to 0.0776 m after an independent diagnostic Sim3, proving that inter-segment gauge drift dominates its local shape error

minimum_three_point_pose_consistent_scre.gate: rotation error <= 1 degree and translation direction cosine >= 0.99; scale ratio is not used for selection

dense_metric_motion_observability.interpretation: dense same-frame metric observations provide only isolated three-point hypotheses in the drift region, not enough independently supported cross-frame motion to anchor a submap-scale solve

conclusion: Correct post-registration ordering preserves the frozen registration frontier and dense support materially improves reprojection and slightly improves RMSE. Independent segment alignment proves inter-segment gauge drift. Adjacent-only dense chains recover 27,976 multi-frame metric tracks at 1.28 GiB, but fixed-end refinement leaves the drift and scale-moving BA is unstable. Exposing unvalidated tracklets incrementally improves the small component to 0.064 m RMSE but biases the dominant component even when the base seed is frozen. A two-pass base-pose reprojection screen is also unsafe because it circularly accepts self-consistent aliases, loses four registrations, and reaches 1.248 m RMSE. Exact stereo-temporal quadrilaterals recover 38,740 independent four-observation tracks at 1.22 GiB, but post-registration use leaves RMSE/p95 at 0.3907/0.7737 m. Exposing them after the frozen seed still biases the dominant component to 0.758 m RMSE. A pose-free forward/backward LK intersection accepts 59,948 candidates and is bounded, but loses 18 registrations while leaving RMSE/p95 at 0.3904/0.7645 m. Adjacent identity evidence is exhausted; the next quality boundary is a bounded independently verified long-range constraint that can correct inter-segment gauge drift.
